header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Satram Sonani Bheel, advocate for the petitioners a/w petitioners.
Mr. Ghulamullah Memon, A.A.G a/w I.O of crime No.42/2026 of P.S Shadi Palli.
body: Through the instant petition, the petitioners have sought quashment of F.I.R bearing Crime No.42 of 2026, registered under Sections 365-B PPC r/w Section 3(ii) of TIP Act, 2018 at Police Shadi Palli, District Umerkot.

Investigation officer of Crime No.42 of 2026 is present and has recorded the statement of petitioner No.1, wherein she straightaway submits that she being sui juris lady, contracted marriage with petitioner No.2 Sono son of Qadir Bux, with her own free will and without any coercion. She further submits that she was not kidnapped by anyone.

After recording statement of petitioner No.1, the investigation officer submits that he will submit summary for disposal of aforementioned F.I.R under cancelled “C” class before the court having jurisdiction.

In view of above, learned counsel for the petitioners is satisfied and seeks disposal of instant Petition; which is hereby disposed of with directions to the investigation officer to submit such report (as suggested by him) before the court having jurisdiction within 15 days. Official respondents are directed to provide protection to the petitioners in accordance with law.
